about.title: Building reliable enterprise network fabric
about.summary: To obtain a challenging Network Engineer position where I can utilize my expertise in routing, switching, and network security to design, implement, and maintain reliable enterprise network infrastructures. With hands-on experience in LAN/WAN/WLAN technologies, multi-vendor networking platforms, and proactive network monitoring, I aim to enhance network performance, ensure system reliability, and contribute to the development of secure and scalable IT environments while continuously expanding my technical expertise.
highlights: Multi-vendor routing & switching (Cisco, MikroTik, Ruijie, UniFi, Omada)

responsibilities: Designed and implemented scalable LAN/WAN/WLAN infrastructures for enterprise environments to support reliable, high-performance connectivity.
Implemented VLAN segmentation and Quality of Service (QoS) policies to enhance traffic management, efficiency, and service reliability.
Monitored network traffic and system performance using monitoring tools to identify security risks and optimize operations.
Maintained and supported call center network infrastructure, ensuring zero downtime and uninterrupted communication services.
Managed network connectivity across branches and stations for stable inter-branch communication and operational continuity.
Diagnosed and resolved routing, switching, and connectivity issues to minimize service disruptions.
Maintained network documentation including topology diagrams, configurations, and operational procedures.
Configured and optimized routing and switching protocols for efficient data communication.
Applied network security best practices including firewall rules, access control policies, and segmentation.
Installed and configured computer hardware, operating systems, and business software for reliable workstation performance.
Deployed and configured routers, switches, and wireless access points on Cisco, MikroTik, Ruijie, and TP-Link Omada platforms.
Configured Microsoft Outlook including account setup, data migration, and backup management.
Performed Windows installation, configuration, and system updates for stable workstation environments.
Installed and maintained biometric fingerprint systems (BioStar) for secure access control and attendance.
Implemented and configured CCTV surveillance systems for physical security monitoring.
Installed and supported peripheral devices including scanners, printers, and office equipment.
